programme.desc: S1 E20 — Nugget's Muddy MishapWhen Nugget's favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget's happiest memories.

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Gadabout's DanceGadabout gives himself dance fever to prove he is as much fun as Zog and Pearl. When he can't stop boogieing, they must cure him before sunset so he is not stuck dancing forever!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E45 — The Sticky Sauce SituationFabio's yummy new sauce is so sticky that he gets stuck to Mojo's bonnet. They have to do everything together until Bo figures out how to 'unsticky' that sauce!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Bye ByeBing plays with a new orange balloon but when he bounces on it too enthusiastically, it pops. Bing is sad to lose his new toy, so Flop helps him put the balloon fragments in the Bye Bye Box.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S7 E15 — oDee encourages a friend to say `o' and goes on an adventure featuring an octopus, an orangutan, and an ostrich. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds.

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
programme.desc: S1 E45 — Body BeatsWhile searching for unique sounds that their bodies can make, Mum introduces Maddie and Triggs to one of the tiniest sounds of all - the sound of their own heartbeat.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E35 — The Giggle SproutsBrian asks the Piggies to help with his Giggle Sprouts party. Everyone thinks opening the pot will be easy, but it is actually impossible!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: S4 E22 — More About PopThe Twirlywoos are in a room full of model aeroplanes watching a model maker starting a new project. As the man unpacks the parts of his model plane, he can't help but pop some of the bubble wrap packaging. The Twirlywoos think this looks like great fun, and they decide to pop the bubble wrap too - much to the man's surprise! Back on the Big Red Boat, the Twirlywoo Screen entertains with a bubble-blowing fish. Soon there are bubbles everywhere, just waiting to be popped!

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S13 E15 — We're All Friends: Let's Go CampingJustin and his friends are at a campsite having lots of fun in the great outdoors. Mr Tumble and Tumble Ted go on a camping trip of their own.

programme.title: Mr Tumble
programme.desc: Let's Play!Sing and sign along with Mr Tumble about being brave, friends, sharing and manners.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S1 E46 — Keep FitThe Teletubbies feel tired after doing keep fit exercises, but they are ready for action again after eating lots of tubby custard. In Tummy Tales, a child keeps fit on a beach.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: S2 E19 — Episode 19Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Joseph, Baani, Jean, Amber, Amelia, Luke and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside everyone's bags are dollies which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding a safe, baby appropriate dolly inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby!

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: S1 E24 — Wind Farm BeachElsie plays I Spy whilst on a beach walk with Mohamoud.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Tidying UpJames, Noah and Aaron are on a mission to tidy up the city centre garden for a party. They work with Chatterpot's friends - a rake, a spade and Wheely the wheelbarrow.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: S2 E9 — Musical Fence and Postbox WalkRanger Hamza and the Ramblers walk to a postbox to send a letter. On the way, they play a musical fence, meet a ladybird, listen to the sound of water barrels and even blast off like a rocket!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: S3 E8 — ColoursSorry takes her friends on a journey into colour and sound.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E22 — The PoolBluey and dad tease mum about being fussy when packing to go to the pool, but when they arrive underprepared, they realise that mum was right all along.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E32 — The Voice BadgeBetty sounds like Roly, Norrie sounds like Tag, and Duggee sounds like Enid! The Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices. It is clear something has gone awry. Do not worry, Duggee has his voice badge, and he knows what to do.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Purple's PatternsThe Colourblocks decorate Purple's garden and learn about patterns. Discover how to make patterns with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: S2 E14 — Chantelle and Rory: StarfishJames finds out all about some very cool sea creatures - starfish. Chantelle is with Dawood to investigate different types of starfish - one with chocolate chips and another that looks like a cushion.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: S6 E14 — Audrey Goes to the FarmAudrey and her family visit a farm. They meet some of the animals up close, and Audrey feeds the guinea pigs with a carrot treat before enjoying cuddles with a baby goat. Then it's off for a tractor ride, where Audrey meets a horse with a moustache.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: S2 — Mala the MermaidThe two chefs are pretending to have a beach holiday, but they haven't got a flag for Small's sandcastle or a sun hat for Jen. Mala the mermaid comes to visit, Small finds out how spinach grows, and they cook delicious sweet potato boats for their enchanting guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Mission: Wake Up!Hearing dog Diesel is on an important mission, to wake his teenage owner Rayane, who's deaf, up in time for his football trial. There's a big match tomorrow, and Rayane really wants to be picked for the team. It's the summer holidays, so Rayane and Diesel have been sleeping in. Diesel needs to be on high alert! Diesel's superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane's ears.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E10 — Colour DayThe class arrives wearing brightly coloured clothes for a fun-filled activity day. There's a colourful science experiment and a colour safari adventure around the school.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S4 E9 — Waffle's Dog FamilyWaffle feels left out of the Brooklyn-Bells' fun, so he sets off to find his doggy family. Later, Mrs Hobbs meets Pepper.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S3 E3 — Rise and ShineIsabelle is staying with Oona for the night.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E35 — SunriseStripes and Toad see a beautiful sunrise and decide to write a song about it together, but Stripes wants the song to be rocky, while Toad wants it to be slower. When they fall out and go off to write their own songs separately, Yukee tries to help them become friends again and create one song together.

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
programme.desc: S1 E6 — EchoesMaddie and Triggs are helping Dad in the garden. When he asks them to fill the catering can, they get distracted by the strange echoes inside and are magically transported to inside the belly of a whale.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E45 — Brave Knight RebeccaThe Piggies build a castle so that Rebecca can be a knight and start an epic quest. But will everything go smoothly with Wilf as the dragon?

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S4 E27 — The Big OneOne has found a way to keep adding Ones all the way to Ninety-nine. But what on earth comes next? Learn to count to 99 or so with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S4 E10 — BlueU is upside-down, next to an upside-down tree, and the whole of Alphaland is blue. How did that happen?

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S12 E1 — We're All Friends: BasketballBouncy fun as Justin and his friend join a basketball team for the day and learn some new skills. Mr Tumble has a new ball of his own, but this ball is a little bit too bouncy.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S1 E53 — MusicThe Teletubbies become a pop group and perform a pop song. In Tummy Tales, children watch a one-man band playing music and accompany him by playing their own music.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Andy and the Prehistoric PicnicAndy heads out to Dino Island for a practically perfect prehistoric picnic, but unusual ground tremors and hungry dinosaurs threaten to ruin his lunch plans.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: S5 E20 — Goodbye Molly and MackIt's Molly and Mack's last day in the Big Hub. They both tell each other that they don't want a goodbye party, but they really do. Caitlin has big plans, and a great time is had by all.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S2 E9 — Stand-up MachinesGrace shows off three amazing machines that you have to stand up on. Grace rides an electric surfboard, shows off a jet hoverboard and then goes for a ride through the forest on an off-road personal transporter.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Perfect Pineapple Party DayLove Monster's pineapple costume makes it difficult for him to participate in any of the party events.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: S3 E6 — Copy ThatThe innocent-looking Dragonfruitflyus has a cheeky habit of mimicking the noises of other Vegesaurs, so when the baby Pea-Rexes catch on, they cannot help but turn it into a competition.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts and the Little GobyAfter a tropical storm carries a little goby out to sea, the Vegimals and Kwazii set off to return the fish to their home atop a waterfall by going on a steep climb and avoiding predators.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of the Uninvited BadgerWhen Tommy Brock decides he's had enough of the cold, he takes shelter by the fire inside the Bouncer's Burrow. It's up to Peter and his friends to devise a way of getting the grumpy badger out and to make sure he doesn't come back!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E39 — The Football BadgeDuggee and the squirrels decide to play football. Duggee starts the game by kicking the ball to the squirrels, who look at it blankly. They don't know what to do - they've never played football before. Worm, Hennie and Ethel do their best to show them the rules, but it's all going in the wrong direction. How will they ever score a goal?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S1 E40 — The Puppet Show BadgeDuggee and the squirrels had a great adventure outside and want to tell everyone about it. What better way to tell a story than through a puppet show? First, they make the puppets, using scissors, card, glue, glitter and feathers. Then it's time for an amazing show for all their friends! But wait a minute... who is this unexpected guest in the big black car?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E15 — Lantern ParadeThe school is having a very special lantern parade, so each child gets to make their very own lantern with their face on. Oliver and Felicity are making theirs with help from Mrs Collins. They use a milk bottle for the body, pipe cleaners for arms and coloured paper for clothes, then they add a photo of their face. Once the lanterns have been made, the children hang them on a wire in the playground ready for the parade.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S4 E12 — Evil Peamobile Goes RogueEvil Pea makes her car voice controlled, but it gets cross when she isn't nice to it.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Mission RollercoasterWeasy is banned from playing on the ducklings' mini train but decides to go up a level.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: S2 E10 — PopularA new country is discovered, and the most popular person in the world will be chosen to move there. Wizz discovers it could be him and desperately tries to reduce his popularity in order to stay home.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E5 — OmeletteBingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E21 — EscapeMum and Dad tell Bluey and Bingo that they're dropping them off at Nana's so they can have some time to themselves. The girls are outraged and imagine an elaborate plan to infiltrate their parent's private time.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E19 — The Great Gnome GamesAfter 799 years of winning the Great Gnome Games, Great Gnanna is worried she can't defend her title. To help, the doctors remind her she is just as fearsome as ever.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: S1 E1 — First DayIt's the first day of Pup School. Dodge overcomes his first-day-nerves as he meets lots of new friends. The pups settle into their class activities with their new teacher Miss Collie.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Waffle Tries To Be StillIt's Bring-a-Toy-to-School Day, so Evie takes the trolley she's just been given for her fifth birthday. Waffle hides in it and ends up in Evie's class, where he must keep very still so he isn't seen.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Lost and Found WishRafi's lost toy ends up with Oscar. She sees that passing things on can also bring joy.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S3 E22 — Summer: It's Time for a Canal WalkJoJo and Gran Gran are enjoying a canal walk when they meet Ned and Monty. Ned is looking for the lock key, so they can take their canal boat through the lock and along the canal. JoJo decides she and Gran Gran will help them search for it.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S3 E17 — Cake DecorateCake decides to teach Sarah and Duck how to decorate with icing.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E11 — Major's Low-Gravity BackpackIt's the Clangers' cleaning day. All the Clangers are doing a good job dusting, but how will they reach all the dust weeds they can see on the ceiling of the living cave?

programme.desc: New Tastes. Mary explores new ways to cook and eat. She makes a tasty Nordic seeded loaf, a pan-fried prawn dish and a contemporary take on a passion fruit tart. S1, Ep2

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James's adventure takes him to St Émilion, where he first fell in love with food. He visits the Chateau Cheval Blanc and the L'Hostellerie Plaisance kitchens. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James travels to the glorious Canal du Midi where he indulges in delicious seafood. He trades a little work aboard a boat for a traditional cuttlefish treat. S1, Ep2

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Sardinia. The bikers begin the Sardinian part of their adventure in the small town of Cagliari, where the locals are in high spirits for the feast of St Efisio. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: Camembert Parcels And Golden Chicken. Jamie makes crispy Camembert parcels, autumn salad and cranberry dip, plus golden chicken with braised greens and potato gratin. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: Beef Stroganoff And Moroccan Mussels. Jamie rustles up a beef stroganoff with rice, red onion and parsley pickle. Later, he makes Moroccan mussels with tapenade toasties and salad. S1, Ep4

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Home Sweet Home: In Minutes. Ree makes quick family meals at home on the ranch. There's pork marsala with mushrooms, grilled shrimp panzanella and spinach artichoke calzones. S25, Ep10

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E8In 1943, the inmates of the Death Camp at Sobibor staged an organised rebellion against their Nazi oppressors.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1In the waters of Scapa Flow, discover sunken dreadnoughts that tell the story of how a U-Boat sank HMS Royal Oak. Later, on HMS Cavalier, we explore how a raid by commandos called Operation Chariot proved the vulnerability of the battleship.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E3At the Altaussee salt mine, Guy Walters and Justine discover replicas of looted masterpieces and reflect on miners’ efforts to save priceless works from Nazi destruction. At Hans’s mountain home, they study diagrams of vanished art.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E4Guy Walters and Justine follow one of the most famous legends of WWII: the Wałbrzych Gold Train. Their search through Poland blends tense encounters, eccentric characters, and moments of farce as they try to separate fact from fantasy.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E4From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E1Mussolini joins Hitler in his fight against the Allies, while Winston Churchill is appointed British Prime Minister on the day of the Blitzkrieg, the German invasion of France.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E2Germany continues to build its empire in Europe, occupying Poland, Czechoslovakia, Austria, Luxembourg, Norway, Denmark, The Netherlands and Belgium. France is conquered and divided as Churchill rejects any attempt at an armistice.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E1The world had largely ignored the growing threat of Nazism during the late 1930s and now the appeasement of Hitler was about to have terrible consequences.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E2With the fall of France, only Britain stood between Hitler and complete victory in Europe. But German High Command knew that it first had to have mastery of the skies.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E1Ranged weapons guarantee a warrior's best chance of survival. International experts survey history’s most important ranged weapons, from the Roman spear and the English longbow, right up to the futuristic railgun.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E2Examining how warfare entered a new dimension as attacks from the skies became possible with weapons from incendiary arrows to drones.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: World War Weird
